question: Which of the following statements is CERTAIN concerning Angiotensin II in glomerular filtration?

options.opa: Angiotensin II preferentially contracts the efferent arterioles in most physiological states, raising the hydrostatic glomerular pressure.
options.opb: The afferent arteries are especially sensitive to Angiotensin II-mediated dilation in most of the physiological states associated with the activation of the renin-angiotensin system.
options.opc: Increased Angiotensin II concentrations decrease the hydrostatic glomerular pressure, increasing renal blood flow.
options.opd: Angiotensin II, with its arteriolar constriction action, contributes to the reduction of sodium and water reabsorption.
